content.comment_body: Hello, My [product_name] is locked due to a customer password that has been forgotten. Is there any way to remove this password? Thank you for your help, [user_name] from Brazil

To reset the password for [product_name], try using the 'Clear user name & password' function found under tools -> transfer. If this doesn't work, you may need to contact your supplier for assistance. Regards, [user_name]

Hello [user_name], If there were a hidden way to access [product_name], password protection wouldn't be effective. It's not appropriate to share unlock methods on the forum. Please follow the process described by [user_name]. Alternatively, if you need to remove the password during program editing, copy all blocks into a new project. More details can be found here: [url] Hope this helps. Regards

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter difficulties when a password for a [product_name] device is forgotten and look for solutions to reset or remove it. Responses emphasize security, clarify that there are no undocumented methods for bypassing passwords, and suggest accepted workflows such as copying logic into a new project, highlighting challenges with usability and access in [company_name] products.
analysis.user_expectations: User hopes for a simple, supported way to reset or remove a forgotten password on a [product_name] device without needing to recreate programs or contact the supplier.
